projects.title: The Budding Space Project
projects.summary: A school-based initiative designed to help children make informed choices, develop leadership skills and become positive influences in their communities.
intendedActivities: School seminars and guided discussions about responsible choices, technology and drug abuse prevention.
Engagement with school leaders and experienced role models.
Learning materials and opportunities for children to share what they learn.
Practical skills training as part of the proposed programme.

sections.heading: Purpose and approach
paragraphs: The Budding Space Project brings guidance, leadership development and practical learning into school communities. It addresses the pressures children face online and offline, including harmful influences, drug abuse and a lack of positive role models.

The project plan proposes regular sessions across the school year, with topics shaped around young people’s questions. School authorities and experienced leaders would support the sessions and help children put their learning into practice.

sections.heading: Supporting lasting learning
paragraphs: Children are encouraged to pass on useful lessons within their communities. The plan also includes a concluding skills programme to build confidence and practical capability.

projects.title: Scholarship for Rural Indigent Children
projects.summary: An education initiative to help children in rural Enugu communities overcome financial barriers to schooling through tuition support, learning materials and practical skills.
projects.location: Rural communities in Enugu State, Nigeria
intendedActivities: Identify children facing financial barriers to schooling in collaboration with school authorities.
Support tuition and essential academic materials.
Encourage learning through an essay competition, guidance and progress reviews.
Introduce practical skills such as crocheting, baking, beadwork and household product making.

sections.heading: Keeping education within reach
paragraphs: The scholarship initiative responds to the financial pressures that prevent children in rural Enugu communities from attending school. Its plan combines school fees and academic materials with support from teachers and school leaders.

The proposed approach includes identifying children who have left school because of household hardship, including those who have lost a family breadwinner. Guidance and academic reviews are intended to help beneficiaries maintain progress.

sections.heading: Learning for life
paragraphs: Alongside formal education, the project proposes practical skills training to expand young people’s capabilities and future livelihood options.

stories.title: Turning Policy Into Protection: Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children at the Enugu VAPP Law & SToP Guidelines Workshop
stories.summary: Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children joined stakeholders in Enugu from 29 June to 1 July 2026 to strengthen the implementation of protections for women, girls and vulnerable people.
stories.author: Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children

data.text: Our Programs Officer represented Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children at a three-day policy workshop in Enugu from 29 June to 1 July 2026. The discussions focused on putting the state’s Violence Against Persons (Prohibition) Law and Safe Termination of Pregnancy guidelines into practice.

LifeSpring Development Foundation convened the workshop with the Enugu State Ministry of Health. Representatives of government, health services, the judiciary, security agencies, civil society, the media and faith communities considered how clearer responsibilities and stronger coordination could improve protection.

Through discussions and validation sessions, participants examined implementation gaps and ways to improve collaboration and public awareness. Jedidiah Cares Global Outreach for Women, Youth and Children contributed the perspective of the women, youth and children at the centre of our work. Our commitment is to support the steps that turn policy into practical protection and access to services.
